summary: Tuesday's close extended the recent pattern: growth stocks kept lagging defensives sharply (QQQ -4.2% vs XLP +1.2%), while broader breadth held up as equal-weight outperformed the S&P. Volatility stayed stuck above its average, keeping flows tilted toward Treasuries and gold even as crypto stayed pinned near oversold levels.
tweet: Growth still lagging defensives, VIX stuck above average, crypto oversold near-term floor, bonds and gold absorbing the haven bid.
